name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)` requires a switch toggle before reaching the exit, but the environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” In those setups, `switch_toggled` cannot occur, so the clause cannot be satisfied. Ensure the task only runs in setups with a switch, or change the environment so every setup has one.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) cannot be satisfied in setups without a siren. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch,” so switch_toggled cannot occur there, yet the clause requires it before the exit. The task is impossible in those setups; limit it to setups with a switch or change the task requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Hard `Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)` with hard `Existence(at_exit)` requires a switch toggle before finishing. But the environment says, “A missing siren has no switch and `siren_ringing` is never true,” so `switch_toggled` cannot occur in those setups. The task cannot be satisfied across the supplied environment unless it guarantees the switch exists or does not require flipping it in setups without one.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) requires flipping the switch first. The environment prevents toggling and reaching the exit on the same step.

texts: Flip the switch before reaching the exit.
